 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT – STATIC LANDING PAGE FOR FINTECH E-COMMERCE APP “PayCart Flow” Create a premium modern static website landing page for a fintech e-commerce product called PayCart Flow. It is a checkout/payment optimization tool for online stores, but the website must be ONLY static front-end, no backend, no login, no real payments, no API, no database, no live data. Use mock/sample content only. Build in React with simple UI components and clean Material Design style. Visual inspiration: Spotify style landing page energy — dark background, bold typography, green accent color, large rounded cards, smooth gradients, modern product mockups, confident marketing copy. BRANDING: Main color: fintech green #1DB954 / neon green accent. Secondary: white, charcoal, dark gray. Background: deep dark #070A0F with subtle green gradient blobs. Style: Material Design + Spotify-inspired + fintech trust + e-commerce conversion. Must feel premium, trustworthy, modern, and easy to understand. Website type: static landing page / marketing site. Target audience: Shopify/WooCommerce-style store owners, DTC brands, small online shops, fintech SaaS buyers. IMPORTANT: Everything must be static and self-contained. Chatbot is just a front-end demo widget with prewritten messages and buttons, no AI API, no real chat service. Any dashboards, charts, transactions, cards, customers, product stats, testimonials must use mock data only. PAGE STRUCTURE: 1) TOP NAVIGATION Sticky header with logo PayCart Flow, nav links: Features, How It Works, Pricing, Reviews, FAQ. CTA button: Start Free Demo. Dark transparent nav with blur, green hover states, material shadow. Mobile responsive hamburger or simple stacked nav. 2) HERO SECTION Left side: small badge “Fintech checkout for modern e-commerce”. Big headline: “Turn abandoned carts into paid orders.” Subheadline: “A static demo of a smart payment experience that helps online stores explain faster checkout, flexible payment options, and automated cart recovery.” CTA buttons: “View Demo Flow” and “Explore Pricing”. Trust microcopy: “No real payments • Static prototype • Mock data only”. Right side: beautiful material dashboard mockup card showing Checkout Conversion, Revenue Recovered, Cart Recovery Rate, Payment Success, mini chart bars, order list, and green glowing payment card. Include floating cards: “+38% checkout completion”, “2.4s faster checkout”, “Smart cart nudge”, “Mock chatbot active”. 3) SOCIAL PROOF STRIP Add logo strip with fake brands: NOVA MART, URBAN BOX, FRESHLY, TECH CART, ECO HOME. Keep it clean, gray/white logos, no external images needed. 4) PROBLEM SECTION Title: “Checkout friction costs stores money.” Use 3 material cards: Complicated payment steps, abandoned carts, unclear financing options. Each with icon-style simple emoji or CSS icon, short copy. 5) SOLUTION SECTION Title: “A smoother payment story for every shopper.” 4 feature cards: One-tap checkout preview, Flexible payment messaging, Cart recovery chatbot, Conversion analytics snapshot. Make cards dark with green borders/glow on hover. 6) INTERACTIVE STATIC CHATBOT DEMO SECTION Very important: include a visible chatbot widget/card as part of landing page interaction. It should look like a fintech shopping assistant named “FlowBot”. The chatbot is static/scripted only. User can click preset chips like: “Why did I abandon cart?”, “Show financing message”, “Recover my order”, “Apply shipping reminder”. When clicked, the UI can display prewritten static responses only. No backend, no API, no real AI. Example bot messages: “Looks like the shopper paused at shipping. Try a free-shipping threshold banner.” “Offer Pay-in-4 messaging before the final checkout step.” “Send a friendly cart reminder with product image and savings note.” Make the chatbot beautiful: rounded material card, green online dot, message bubbles, quick reply chips, fake typing indicator optional using CSS/JS only. 7) E-COMMERCE CHECKOUT MOCKUP SECTION Show a fake checkout screen with product items: Wireless Desk Lamp $49, Minimal Backpack $89, subtotal, shipping, total. Include payment method chips: Card, Wallet, Pay Later. Add trust badges: Secure checkout, encrypted payment, buyer protection. Again no real payment, just static mockup. 8) HOW IT WORKS SECTION 3 steps with numbers: Connect your store message, Personalize checkout nudges, Recover more carts. But wording must clarify this is a marketing prototype / static showcase. Use horizontal timeline on desktop, vertical on mobile. 9) FEATURE GRID SECTION More detailed: Smart payment banners, abandoned cart nudges, discount reminder, order confidence badges, mobile-first checkout, conversion report preview. Use Material Design cards with icons and concise text. 10) PRICING SECTION Static pricing cards only, no checkout. Plans: Starter $19/mo mock, Growth $49/mo mock, Scale $99/mo mock. Add features. Highlight Growth with green outline and badge “Most popular”. Buttons say “Preview Plan” not purchase. Add note: “Static pricing for demo purposes.” 11) TESTIMONIALS SECTION Use 3 fake testimonials with names and roles: Maya Chen, Founder of Urban Box; Rafael Moore, E-commerce Manager; Lina Patel, DTC Growth Lead. Include star ratings and short quotes. 12) FAQ SECTION Accordion style if possible with front-end only. Questions: Is this a real payment processor? Does the chatbot use AI? Can I connect my store? Is data live? Answers must say this is a static landing page demo using mock/sample content, no real integrations. 13) FINAL CTA SECTION Big Spotify-like green gradient panel: “Make checkout feel effortless.” Buttons: “Launch Static Demo” and “See Features”. 14) FOOTER Columns: Product, Resources, Company. Include disclaimer: “PayCart Flow is a static front-end concept. No real payments, accounts, APIs, or financial services are provided.” DESIGN REQUIREMENTS: Material Design cards, rounded corners 18-28px, soft shadows, green glow accents, dark theme, premium SaaS style, responsive mobile-first. Use modern font style similar Inter / system font. Smooth hover animations, subtle fade-in sections if simple CSS only. No external paid assets. Use CSS gradients and simple icons. Must look polished like a real fintech product landing page. TECH REQUIREMENTS: React static app, simple HTML/CSS/JS only inside React components. No backend. No authentication. No database. No API calls. No Stripe/PayPal/OpenAI/analytics integrations. No external services. No real forms sending data. If email field exists, it is visual only and can show a local static message like “Demo only”. Deliver a complete static landing page with responsive layout, reusable components, and sample content hardcoded.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
